tmua-2022-p1-q1.summary: Count the angles in $[0,2\pi]$ for which $2\cos^4\theta-5\cos^2\theta+3=0$.
tmua-2022-p1-q1.summaryZh: 求 $2\cos^4\theta-5\cos^2\theta+3=0$ 在 $[0,2\pi]$ 内的解数。

methods.title: Factor in the squared cosine
methods.titleZh: 对余弦平方进行因式分解
steps: Set $t=\cos^2\theta$. The polynomial is $(2t-3)(t-1)$; $t=3/2$ is outside the allowable interval $[0,1]$.
For $t=1$ the angles are $0,\pi,2\pi$. The two endpoints are distinct members of the requested interval.
stepsZh: 令 $t=\cos^2\theta$，则多项式为 $(2t-3)(t-1)$。因 $0\le t\le1$，排除 $t=3/2$。
余下 $t=1$ 给出 $0,\pi,2\pi$。区间的两个端点是两个不同的解。

tmua-2022-p1-q2.summary: When does $x^2-2px+y^2-6y-p^2+8p+9=0$ define a circle of positive radius?
tmua-2022-p1-q2.summaryZh: 使 $x^2-2px+y^2-6y-p^2+8p+9=0$ 表示半径为正的圆，参数 $p$ 应取何值？

methods.title: Read the squared radius
methods.titleZh: 读出半径平方
steps: Completing both squares gives $(x-p)^2+(y-3)^2=2p^2-8p$.
A genuine circle requires $2p(p-4)>0$, which holds outside the two roots. At $p=0,4$ only one point remains.
stepsZh: 要得到半径为正的圆，须有 $2p(p-4)>0$，故取两根外侧。若 $p=0,4$，轨迹只含一点。

tmua-2022-p1-q3.summary: A function has constant second derivative $a$, values $f(0)=1,f(1)=2$, and integral $\int_0^1f(x)\,dx=1$. Determine $a$.
tmua-2022-p1-q3.summaryZh: 函数的二阶导数恒为 $a$，且 $f(0)=1,f(1)=2,\int_0^1 f(x)\,dx=1$。求 $a$。

methods.title: Fit the endpoint values first
methods.titleZh: 先拟合端点值
steps: A function with these endpoint values and constant second derivative is $f(x)=1+x+(a/2)x(x-1)$: the final term vanishes at both ends and contributes second derivative $a$.
Its integral is $3/2+(a/2)(1/3-1/2)=3/2-a/12$. Equating this with $1$ gives $a=6$.
stepsZh: 满足端点条件且二阶导数恒为 $a$ 的函数为 $f(x)=1+x+(a/2)x(x-1)$；最后一项在两端均为零，二阶导数为 $a$。

tmua-2022-p1-q4.summary: Two similar sectors have radii $r$ and $r+3$. The shorter arc has length $6$, and the larger area exceeds the smaller by $21$. Find the difference in perimeters.
tmua-2022-p1-q4.summaryZh: 相似的两个扇形半径为 $r,r+3$。小扇形弧长为 $6$，两者的面积差为 $21$。求周长之差。

methods.title: Fix the common angle
methods.titleZh: 利用共同圆心角
steps: The common angle is $6/r$ radians. The area difference is $(3/r)((r+3)^2-r^2)=18+27/r$. Equating this to $21$ gives $r=9$.
With angle $2/3$, perimeter equals radius times $(2+2/3)$. A radius increase of $3$ therefore adds $8$ to the perimeter.
stepsZh: 此时角为 $2/3$，周长等于半径乘以 $2+2/3$。半径增加 3，周长增加 8。

tmua-2022-p1-q5.summary: Successive terms follow $x_{n+1}=(x_n+p)/(x_n+q)$. The initial three are $3,5,7$. Determine the fourth term.
tmua-2022-p1-q5.summaryZh: 数列满足 $x_{n+1}=(x_n+p)/(x_n+q)$，开头三项为 $3,5,7$。求第四项。

methods.title: Fit the fractional recurrence
methods.titleZh: 确定分式递推的参数
steps: The first two transitions give $3+p=15+5q$ and $5+p=35+7q$. Subtracting gives $2=20+2q$, so $q=-9$, $p=-33$.
At the next step the denominator is $7-9=-2$ and the numerator is $7-33=-26$, giving $13$.

tmua-2022-p1-q6.summary: The integral of $x$ from $\log_2 5$ to $\log_2 20$ equals $\log_2 M$. Determine $M$.
tmua-2022-p1-q6.summaryZh: $x$ 从 $\log_2 5$ 到 $\log_2 20$ 的定积分为 $\log_2 M$，求 $M$。

methods.title: Factor the difference of endpoint squares
methods.titleZh: 利用端点平方差
steps: Write the bounds as $L,U$. The integral is $(U^2-L^2)/2=(U-L)(U+L)/2$.
Logarithm rules give $U-L=\log_2 4=2$ and $U+L=\log_2 100$. Thus $M=100$.

tmua-2022-p1-q7.summary: Find the bounded area between the horizontal axis and $y=x^2-4|x|-12$.
tmua-2022-p1-q7.summaryZh: 求横轴与曲线 $y=x^2-4|x|-12$ 围成的有限区域面积。

methods.title: Halve the even region
methods.titleZh: 利用关于纵轴的对称性
steps: On $x\ge0$, $y=(x-6)(x+2)$ is nonpositive up to $x=6$ and positive afterwards. The curve is even.
Doubling the area on the positive half-axis gives $2\int_0^6(12+4x-x^2)\,dx=2(72+72-72)=144$.
stepsZh: 在非负半轴上 $y=(x-6)(x+2)$，其在 $[0,6]$ 内不为正，之后为正。整条曲线关于纵轴对称。

tmua-2022-p1-q8.summary: A geometric progression has positive integer first term and integer ratio $r>1$. If $S_n$ is its first-$n$ sum, find the smallest possible value of $(S_{30}-S_{20})/S_{10}$.
tmua-2022-p1-q8.summaryZh: 一等比数列的首项为正整数，公比为大于 1 的整数 $r$。记前 $n$ 项和为 $S_n$，求 $(S_{30}-S_{20})/S_{10}$ 的最小值。

methods.title: Shift a block of ten terms
methods.titleZh: 平移十项的一组
steps: The numerator sums terms 21 to 30. Each is $r^{20}$ times the corresponding term numbered 1 to 10.
The ratio of these block sums is $r^{20}$, increasing for positive $r$. The least permitted integer ratio is $2$.
stepsZh: 分子是第 21 至 30 项之和，各项分别等于第 1 至 10 项的 $r^{20}$ 倍。
所以两组和之比为 $r^{20}$，当 $r>0$ 时随 $r$ 递增。取允许的最小整数公比 $2$ 时得到最小值。

tmua-2022-p1-q9.summary: Real functions obey $f(x)-g(x)=2\sin x$ and $f(x)g(x)=\cos^2x$ for every real $x$. What is the lowest attainable value of $f(x)$ across such pairs?
tmua-2022-p1-q9.summaryZh: 实函数满足对一切 $x$ 都有 $f(x)-g(x)=2\sin x$ 及 $f(x)g(x)=\cos^2x$。在所有这样的函数对和自变量中，$f(x)$ 能达到的最小值是多少？

methods.title: Complete a square in the unknown function value
methods.titleZh: 对未知函数值配方
steps: Substitute $g=f-2\sin x$ into the product and complete the square. This gives $(f-\sin x)^2=\sin^2x+\cos^2x=1$, so $f=\sin x\pm1$ pointwise.
Both branches are realisable, for example take $f=\sin x-1$, $g=-1-\sin x$. Then $f=-2$ when $\sin x=-1$, and neither branch can go lower.
stepsZh: 由 $g=f-2\sin x$ 代入乘积条件，配方得 $(f-\sin x)^2=\sin^2x+\cos^2x=1$。所以每点处 $f=\sin x\pm1$。
例如取 $f=\sin x-1,g=-1-\sin x$ 即可达到较低分支。当 $\sin x=-1$ 时有 $f=-2$，任一分支都不可能更小。

tmua-2022-p1-q10.summary: Which cubic expressions can be obtained by translating $y=x^3$? (I) $x^3-3x^2+9x-27$, (II) $x^3-9x^2+27x-3$, (III) $27x^3-9x^2+x-3$.

methods.title: Match the coefficients of a translated cube
methods.titleZh: 比较平移后的三次式系数
steps: Translation gives $(x-h)^3+k$, with coefficients $1,-3h,3h^2$ on the three highest powers. In (I), $h=1$ would give linear coefficient $3$, not $9$; (III) already has the wrong leading coefficient.
Expression (II) equals $(x-3)^3+24$, so it is obtained by translating right by three and up by 24.
stepsZh: 平移后必形如 $(x-h)^3+k$，前三个幂次的系数依次为 $1,-3h,3h^2$。（I）要求 $h=1$，一次项系数应为 3，却为 9；（III）的最高次项系数不为 1。
（II）等于 $(x-3)^3+24$，对应向右平移 3、向上平移 24。

methods.title: Sum the exponents first
methods.titleZh: 先求指数的和
steps: The power rule makes every summand $(1-n)\log_{10}3$. Its multipliers are $0,-1,\ldots,-99$.
Their sum is $-99\cdot100/2=-4950$. Multiplying by the common logarithm gives the stated result.
stepsZh: 由对数的幂法则，每项为 $(1-n)\log_{10}3$，乘数依次是 $0,-1,\ldots,-99$。
乘数总和为 $-99\cdot100/2=-4950$，再乘公共因子 $\log_{10}3$ 即可。

tmua-2022-p1-q12.summary: Among the curves $y=2(x-k/2)^2+k^2/2+4k+3$ indexed by real $k$, the global lowest point is $(a,b)$. Find $a+b$.
tmua-2022-p1-q12.summaryZh: 曲线族 $y=2(x-k/2)^2+k^2/2+4k+3$ 中 $k$ 可取任意实数。所有曲线上的最低点为 $(a,b)$，求 $a+b$。

methods.title: Minimise over the coordinate and then the parameter
methods.titleZh: 先对横坐标再对参数求最小值
steps: For each $k$ the vertex has $x=k/2$ and height $k^2/2+4k+3=(k+4)^2/2-5$.
The smallest vertex height is $-5$, at $k=-4$. Its horizontal coordinate is $-2$, so $a+b=-7$.
stepsZh: 当 $k=-4$ 时最低高度为 $-5$，横坐标为 $-2$，所以 $a+b=-7$。

tmua-2022-p1-q13.summaryZh: 非零实数 $a,b$ 满足 $(a^3+2/b^3)(2/a^3-b^3)=\sqrt2$。求 $ab$ 的最小值。

methods.title: Collapse to the cube of the product
methods.titleZh: 换元为乘积的立方
steps: Write $t=(ab)^3$. Expanding cancels the constant terms and leaves $4/t-t=\sqrt2$. The resulting quadratic $t^2+\sqrt2t-4=0$ has roots $\sqrt2,-2\sqrt2$.
The smaller cube root is $-\sqrt2$. Both nonzero products are attainable since one can set $b=1$ and choose the required $a$.
stepsZh: 令 $t=(ab)^3$。展开后常数项相消，得 $4/t-t=\sqrt2$，即 $t^2+\sqrt2t-4=0$，两根为 $\sqrt2,-2\sqrt2$。
开立方后较小者为 $-\sqrt2$。两种乘积均可取到，例如令 $b=1$，再取相应的 $a$。

tmua-2022-p1-q14.summary: A radius-$6$ circle has centre $O$ and chord $PQ$ subtending a non-reflex angle at least $90^\circ$. Triangle $POQ$ has area $9\sqrt3$. Maximise the area of $PRQ$ with $R$ on the circle.
tmua-2022-p1-q14.summaryZh: 半径为 $6$ 的圆中，弦 $PQ$ 对应的不超过平角的圆心角至少 $90^\circ$，且三角形 $POQ$ 面积为 $9\sqrt3$。动点 $R$ 在圆周上，求三角形 $PRQ$ 的最大面积。

methods.title: Maximise height above a fixed chord
methods.titleZh: 固定弦长并最大化高
steps: From $18\sin\angle POQ=9\sqrt3$, the angle is $120^\circ$. The chord has length $12\sin60^\circ=6\sqrt3$ and is $6\cos60^\circ=3$ from the centre.
The farthest point of the circumference from the chord line is on its perpendicular bisector, on the centre's side, giving height $3+6=9$. The maximum area is $(6\sqrt3)(9)/2=27\sqrt3$.
stepsZh: 由 $18\sin\angle POQ=9\sqrt3$ 及角度范围得圆心角 $120^\circ$。弦长 $12\sin60^\circ=6\sqrt3$，圆心到弦的距离为 $6\cos60^\circ=3$。
在弦的垂直平分线上，取与圆心同侧且距弦最远的圆周点，高可达 $3+6=9$，最大面积为 $(6\sqrt3)(9)/2=27\sqrt3$。

tmua-2022-p1-q15.summary: Find the maximum area of an axis-aligned rectangle lying between $y=8-2x^2$ and $y=x^2-2$ in their bounded region.
tmua-2022-p1-q15.summaryZh: 在两曲线 $y=8-2x^2$ 与 $y=x^2-2$ 围成的区域内放置边平行于坐标轴的矩形。求最大面积。

methods.title: First centre the rectangle, then optimise its width
methods.titleZh: 先对称放置再优化宽度
steps: For a fixed width $2t$, the largest absolute value of an endpoint is at least $t$. The outermost endpoint limits both top and bottom, so the greatest height for this width is attained by centring the rectangle and equals $10-3t^2$.
Maximise $A=20t-6t^3$ on $0\le t\le\sqrt{10/3}$. Its derivative $20-18t^2$ changes from positive to negative at $t=\sqrt{10}/3$. Substitution gives $40\sqrt{10}/9$.
stepsZh: 若宽为 $2t$，左右端点的横坐标绝对值中较大者至少为 $t$。该端点同时限制上下边，故将矩形关于纵轴对称放置时可得到同宽下最大高度 $10-3t^2$。
在 $0\le t\le\sqrt{10/3}$ 上最大化 $A=20t-6t^3$。导数 $20-18t^2$ 在 $t=\sqrt{10}/3$ 由正变负，代回得 $40\sqrt{10}/9$。

tmua-2022-p1-q16.summary: The roots of $7x^4-6x^2+1=0$ are $\pm\cos\theta,\pm\cos\beta$. Give a quartic with roots $\pm\sin\theta,\pm\sin\beta$.
tmua-2022-p1-q16.summaryZh: $7x^4-6x^2+1=0$ 的根为 $\pm\cos\theta,\pm\cos\beta$。求以 $\pm\sin\theta,\pm\sin\beta$ 为根的四次方程。

methods.title: Substitute complementary squared values
methods.titleZh: 代入互补的三角函数平方
steps: If $x$ is one of the desired sine values or its negative, then the associated squared cosine is $1-x^2$. It must satisfy $7(1-x^2)^2-6(1-x^2)+1=0$.
Expanding gives $7x^4-8x^2+2=0$. The substitution merely exchanges the two distinct squared cosine values with their complements, recovering the desired roots with both signs.
stepsZh: 若 $x$ 为所求的正负正弦值之一，则对应的余弦平方为 $1-x^2$，满足 $7(1-x^2)^2-6(1-x^2)+1=0$。
展开后得 $7x^4-8x^2+2=0$。此换元把两个不同的余弦平方一一对应到其补数，再分别取正负平方根，恰给出所求根。

tmua-2022-p1-q17.summary: In a triangle a $30^\circ$ angle has opposite side $a=x-1$ and one adjacent side $b=-x^2+6x-5$. Find all $x$ admitting two noncongruent triangles.
tmua-2022-p1-q17.summaryZh: 三角形的一个角为 $30^\circ$，其对边长 $a=x-1$，一条邻边长 $b=-x^2+6x-5$。哪些 $x$ 可对应两个不全等三角形？

methods.title: Test the ambiguous sine-rule case
methods.titleZh: 判断正弦定理的两解情形

topics.en: Ambiguous case of the sine rule

steps: For a given acute angle and adjacent side $b$, the opposite length produces two triangles exactly when $b\sin30^\circ<a<b$: the circle of radius $a$ meets the remaining ray twice strictly in front of its endpoint.
Positivity requires $x>1$ and $b=(x-1)(5-x)>0$. Divide by $x-1$ to obtain $(5-x)/2<1<5-x$, hence $3<x<4$. Both conditions on positivity follow on that interval.
stepsZh: 已知锐角及一条邻边 $b$ 时，只有 $b\sin30^\circ<a<b$ 才有两个三角形；此时以 $a$ 为半径的圆在另一边所在射线上有两个不同的正向交点。

tmua-2022-p1-q18.summary: With $p>0$ and $0<q<r$, consider $x^2(x-1)^2(x-2)=-p(x-q)^2(x-r)^2$. Which of the three intervals $(0,1),(1,2),(2,\infty)$ should contain $q$ and $r$ to guarantee the maximum possible number of distinct real roots for every $p$?
tmua-2022-p1-q18.summaryZh: 设 $p>0,0<q<r$。为使 $x^2(x-1)^2(x-2)=-p(x-q)^2(x-r)^2$ 对每个 $p$ 都有次数所允许的最多个不同实根，应分别将 $q,r$ 放在哪两个区间？候选区间为 $(0,1),(1,2),(2,\infty)$。

methods.title: Alternate the signs at prescribed points
methods.titleZh: 利用特殊点的符号交错
steps: Move the right side to the left and call the quintic $H$. It is negative sufficiently far to the left. Choose $0<q<1<r<2$. At $0,1,2$ the first summand vanishes and the second is positive.

At $q,r$ the second summand vanishes, while the first is negative because $x<2$ and $x$ is neither $0$ nor $1$. The ordered signs at $-\infty,0,q,1,r,2$ are $-,+,-,+,-,+$, forcing five distinct roots. A quintic cannot have more.
stepsZh: 将右边移到左边，记所得五次式为 $H$。当 $x$ 足够小时 $H(x)<0$。取 $0<q<1<r<2$。在 $0,1,2$ 处第一项为零，第二项为正。
在 $q,r$ 处第二项为零，而第一项为负，因为 $x<2$ 且 $x$ 不为 0 或 1。在 $-\infty,0,q,1,r,2$ 六处的符号交替为负、正、负、正、负、正，故有五个不同实根，已达五次式的上限。

tmua-2022-p1-q19.summary: A circle of radius $4$ has centre chosen uniformly in $[-2,2]\times[-3,3]$. Find the chance that its circumference meets the circle of radius $5$ centred at the origin.
tmua-2022-p1-q19.summaryZh: 半径为 $4$ 的圆心在矩形 $[-2,2]\times[-3,3]$ 内均匀选取。求该圆周与以原点为圆心、半径为 $5$ 的圆周相交的概率。

methods.title: Translate intersection into a distance restriction
methods.titleZh: 将相交条件化成圆心距范围
steps: The centre distance $d$ must satisfy $|5-4|\le d\le5+4$. The rectangle has $d\le\sqrt{13}<9$, so the only excluded centres are those with $d<1$.
The unit disk lies entirely inside the rectangle of area $24$. The favourable area is $24-\pi$; the boundary has zero probability.
stepsZh: 圆心距 $d$ 必须满足 $|5-4|\le d\le5+4$。矩形内 $d\le\sqrt{13}<9$，故只需排除 $d<1$ 的圆心。
单位圆盘完全位于面积为 24 的矩形内，所求概率为 $(24-\pi)/24$，边界不影响概率。

tmua-2022-p1-q20.summary: For real $a$, let $n$ count intersections of $y=|x^2-a^2|$ and $y=a^2|x-1|$. Find the smallest positive integer that cannot be $n$.
tmua-2022-p1-q20.summaryZh: 对实数 $a$，记 $y=|x^2-a^2|$ 与 $y=a^2|x-1|$ 的交点数为 $n$。求 $n$ 不可能取到的最小正整数。

methods.title: Split an absolute-value equality into two quadratics
methods.titleZh: 将绝对值等式拆成两个二次方程
steps: Write $t=a^2\ge0$. For $t=0$ there is one intersection. If $t>0$, the equality says $x^2-t=\pm t(x-1)$. The plus sign gives $x=0,t$; the minus sign gives $x^2+tx-2t=0$, which has two distinct nonzero roots of opposite signs.
Only $x=t$ could be shared by the two quadratics. Substitution yields $2t^2-2t=0$, so with $t>0$ overlap occurs exactly at $t=1$. The possible counts are therefore $1,3,4$, missing $2$.
stepsZh: 令 $t=a^2\ge0$。若 $t=0$ 则只有一个交点。若 $t>0$，等式化为 $x^2-t=\pm t(x-1)$。正号给出 $x=0,t$；负号给出 $x^2+tx-2t=0$，有两个不同的异号非零根。
两组根只有 $x=t$ 可能重合，代入得 $2t^2-2t=0$，在正数范围仅当 $t=1$ 成立。因此交点数可能为 $1,3,4$，最小缺项为 2。
